title: Search compatible recipe compositions by typed ports
narrative: Candidate compositions are found by searching only the registered recipes for ones whose declared inputs and outputs fit what is needed. The answer is a list of recipe names; nothing is generated, so no new executable code can enter the production path. A recipe that declares no ports is never suggested, and a type mismatch rules a recipe out. Isolation contracts already exist (`fangore_insp_isolation_io`). Tracks MH-SR-04[^insp-sr-04].
implementation: `search_compatible_recipes(registry, required_inputs, required_outputs)` in `recipe_port_search.py` compares each active recipe's `GraphTemplate.io_contract` (`TemplateIOContract` from `isolation_contract.py`) with the requested ports (type equality, `any` as a wildcard) and returns sorted catalog ids only. `io_contract` is declared on `safety_eval`, `independent_review`, `produce_critique_refine`, `verify_repair`, and `fan_out_aggregate`; other recipes are skipped until they declare ports.
validation: Kind `recipe_port_search`. Hard expects the catalog ids returned for output-only, input-only, combined, wildcard, wrong-type, and unknown-port queries, that every result is a registered catalog id, and that recipes without ports are never returned. Unit tests: `tests/test_recipe_port_search.py`.
